description: Header file defining classes and functions for EFI-related GPIO control, including OutputPin, NamedOutputPin, InjectorOutputPin, IgnitionOutputPin, and EnginePins, along with related macros and external references.

classes.name: OutputPin
classes.description: Represents a single GPIO output pin with methods for initialization, state control, and status tracking.

classes.name: NamedOutputPin
classes.description: Extends OutputPin with a name property and methods to set pin high/low and stop.

classes.name: InjectorOutputPin
classes.description: Extends NamedOutputPin with additional properties for injector control, including schedule timing and counters.

classes.name: IgnitionOutputPin
classes.description: Extends NamedOutputPin with properties for ignition control signals and order status.

classes.name: EnginePins
classes.description: Container class for managing multiple output pins related to engine control, including relays, LEDs, injectors, and ignition coils.

methods.name: turnAllPinsOff
methods.description: Turns off all GPIO pins if EFI_GPIO_HARDWARE is enabled.

methods.name: setDefaultPinState
methods.description: Sets the default state of a pin based on mode.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the pin or pin group.
